title: Finite Bayesian-to-Dominant-Strategy Equivalence
abstract: Finite Gershkov–Goeree–Kushnir–Moldovanu–Shi (2013) Theorem 2 for arbitrary finite agents and alternatives, heterogeneous ordered finite scalar type supports, arbitrary independent positive support masses, and linear private values with nonnegative slopes and arbitrary constants. The library constructs a feasible dominant-strategy mechanism preserving every support type's interim expected utility and ex ante social surplus. Weighted monotone lifting is proved by a compact feasible quadratic minimizer and an improving perturbation. Adjacent transfer bounds imply full-report IC by telescoping. Selected results are finite equivalence, weighted monotone lifting and optimizer monotonicity; scalar IC and support-restriction facts remain in the library as supporting lemmas. Validation evidence is recorded separately for the exact candidate.
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
